verdict.rationale: Docs mention some control mechanisms relevant to security (e.g., disableBundledSkills setting, skill execution in a 'code execution environment' via the container parameter, and requirements like git/docker/jq/internet access), but there is no dedicated security-posture document addressing a trust model for third-party/marketplace skills or any telemetry/data-collection disclosure. Missing for 10: explicit trust/vetting model for third-party skills, telemetry or data-collection statement, sandboxing/execution security details, and any independent audit or hands-on security review.
